# OpenText/Micro Focus VuGen 26.1 Java Vuser lr API (lrapi.lr) supplement.
# Authoritative source: Function Reference > "Alphabetical Listing - Java Utility Functions".
# Format: name,family,support_mode
#
# This file holds ONLY the Java lr methods that have NO snake_case twin in the C
# baseline (source_c_functions_26_1.txt). The 40 Java lr methods that DO match a C
# function (lr.start_transaction↔lr_start_transaction, ...) are resolved through the
# shared C registry by name-normalization in java_import.go and are deliberately not
# duplicated here (a test enforces this file stays disjoint from the C baseline).
lr_deserialize,parameter,review_only
lr_enable_redirection,runtime,native_noop
lr_end_sub_trans,transaction,executable
lr_eval_data,parameter,review_only
lr_eval_int,parameter,executable
lr_get_group_name,info,executable
lr_get_object,parameter,review_only
lr_get_scenario_id,info,executable
lr_get_transaction_wasted_time,transaction,executable
lr_get_vuser_id,info,executable
lr_log,message,executable
lr_read_xml,xml,review_only
lr_redirect,runtime,native_noop
lr_save_data,parameter,review_only
lr_sleep,runtime,executable
lr_value_check,parameter,review_only
